messages:
Alex: Kicking off a staged deploy for llm-route v3. Plan: enable `weighted_sink` flag at 3% -> 10% -> 25% over 30m. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Release tag: r2026-03-23. DeployBot, please schedule the flag ramp.

DeployBot: Scheduled flag ramp for `weighted_sink` on service=llm-route. Initial 3% at 02:05 UTC, ramp steps: 10% @ +10m, 25% @ +30m. Rollback policy attached.

Maya: Can we confirm model pinning? If ramp fails, pin traffic to model rev12.

Liam: I'll pin rev12 on the autoscaler group. Command:
```
./releases/pin_model --service llm-route --model rev12 --duration 60m
```

Olivia: I'll be on-call for metrics. Watching p95 latency, error-rate, and token-cost.

Alex: SLOs: error-rate delta > 0.8% or p95 > 220ms => immediate pause + rollback to 0%. Also watch memory OOMs.

SRE-Bot: NOTE: Preflight checks passed (canary latency ok, infra capacity ok). :white_check_mark:

DeployBot: Flag set to 3%. Starting soak.

Olivia: seeing a small uptick in p95 +8ms, error-rate stable.

SRE-Bot: ALERT: p95 increased 28% in the last 2m. :rotating_light: metric: llm-route.p95 = 235ms vs baseline 183ms.

Alex: Pause ramp. DeployBot, hold next steps and set `weighted_sink` -> 0% if error_rate > 1.0%.

DeployBot: Ramp paused. Next step cancelled. Applying hold. Will revert to 0% on threshold breach.

Maya: Thanks. I'll prepare rollback patch and update release notes: https://confluence.redwood/release/llm-route-v3

Liam: Pin applied to rev12 successfully.

Olivia: Confirming all user-facing errors returned to baseline after pin. Monitoring continues.

Alex: Postmortem if we can't find quick fix. For now, keep flag disabled. Thx :thumbsup:

DeployBot: Final state: `weighted_sink`=0% (rolled back), thread closed.
